principles: Use media when it materially adds context
Use questions and polls only when genuinely answerable

post.body: concise evidence or point of view

length_guidance.post: Concise by default; 50-100 characters is an ad-copy prior, not an organic ranking rule.

link_policy: No universal organic penalty encoded. Make the post valuable without requiring the click and measure account-level outcomes.

cadence_prior.status: high-frequency starting hypothesis; quality and capacity override
